<details>
This PKGBUILD file follows standard Arch Linux packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior. The package "livediff" is a Rust-based real-time file diff visualization tool that fetches its source from the official GitHub repository (github.com/SoCkEt7/Livediff) at a specific tagged release (v3.4.0). The source URL is legitimate and the SHA256 checksum is properly defined (not set to SKIP). The build process uses standard Rust commands (cargo fetch, cargo build --frozen, cargo test --frozen) with the --frozen flag which prevents network access during compilation. The package function installs only the binary, documentation files (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, etc.), and license files to standard system locations. There are no suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, or unexpected system modifications. The maintainer information appears legitimate, and all dependencies are appropriate for a Rust-based application.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
